summary: SPHINCS+ variant with 16-byte hashes and P = 0. A 184-bit message digest (the signer grinds ρ until its last 10 bits are zero) yields 14 FORS+C leaf indices and a 34-bit hypertree index. Five layers of WOTS target-sum signatures (42 chains, digit sum 183) and Merkle paths (heights 11,6,6,6,5) authenticate the FORS key to the 16-byte root. Keygen caches the height-11 top tree as masked nodes under a 256-bit MAC; each PRF call yields two 16-byte secrets. Verification: a constant 11,887 cycles.

facts.label: Digest and FORS+C
facts.value: 184-bit digest = idx (34 b) ‖ u₀…u₁₃ (10 b each) ‖ 10 zero bits; 14 trees of height 10, 176 B each

facts.label: Hypertree
facts.value: 5 layers, heights 11,6,6,6,5 = 34-bit index; layer 4 signs the FORS key; layer 0 = cached top tree, root = pk

facts.label: WOTS encoding
facts.value: Target sum, w = 3: H(tw ‖ P ‖ M ‖ LE32 c) → 42 digits of 3 bits summing to 183; c < 2²², no checksum

facts.label: Keygen cache
facts.value: 128 KiB: 4,094 top-tree nodes (levels 0–10) each ⊕ a PRF mask + 256-bit MAC keyed by the seed

facts.label: Paired PRF secrets
facts.value: One H(tw ‖ P ‖ S) call → 32 B = two 16 B secrets: WOTS chains 2k, 2k+1 and FORS leaves 2k, 2k+1

facts.label: Witness expansion
facts.value: Fixed byte permutation, W = 6,404 B: the 5 counters move to bytes 6,384–6,403 so all 16-byte items are 8-aligned

facts.label: Verification cost
facts.value: 11,887 cycles on every accepting run + ⌈6,404 / 256⌉ = 26 → C = 11,913; 755 HASH calls, 809 blocks

profile.method: 16 random keys and 32-byte messages (seeded PRNG): ref.py keygen (pk + cache), sign with the cache, expand on the emulator, verify traced on vm.py; all accepted at 11,887 cycles
